نبذة

Le Beautique Beauty & Spa is one of the region's top-rated spa and salon. We offer a variety of treatments such as Moroccan Bath, Korean head spa, Henna, Makeup, facial, Haircut and Styling, Hair Treatments, Massage, and more in a luxurious environment. Visit us in Al Maqta, Abu Dhabi to experience great quality services provided by our highly trained staff.

A visit to Le Beautique Beauty & Spa can pair a treatment with small extras, including karak and coffee. Reviews mention Thai massage, Moroccan baths, and henna, alongside hair coloring and makeup; manicure and pedicure services are also available.
